name: spareline-heldout-v1
declared_note: Written after tuning on development-partition groups only and before running any evaluation-partition scenario.
group_selection: All evaluation-partition groups from data/processed/bundle.json (same station + date, 2-4 routes, centroid <= 12 km, departure gap <= 90 min). No exclusions after results.
cutoff_rule: 40% of the donor's reconstructed route duration after departure
objective: lexicographic: missed packages (all vans), helper newly missed (strict 0), late minutes, added drive + wait, moved stops
robustness: recommend only if improvement holds and helper gains no missed package with every cross-route edge at q90
